_comment: Phase API-4A §2 — pinned SDK generation toolchain.
Every generator used to produce sdk/*/generated/ is pinned to an exact
version here. Nothing in the SDK pipeline may use `latest`: a floating
generator makes `generated == regenerated` unprovable, which is the whole
point of §13. Bumping a version here is a deliberate, reviewed act — it
must be accompanied by a regeneration commit and a CHANGELOG entry.
